<div class="card-body">
'''Red 5''' is a [[Light]] [[Starship]] ([[Starfighter]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊レッド5</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">パイロットを1名と、操縦ドロイドを1体追加できる。ルークが操縦しているなら耐：損耗＜4。パイロットなしでは戦闘力、回避力、航行速度を使用できない。「アタック・ラン」で先頭機をつとめている場合、合計値に1を加える。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Red-5-PSA-135901794.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ルークがヤヴィンの戦いで使用したインコムT－65Xウイング。レッド5とT－16スカイホッパーの操縦系統は似通っており、ルークはこの機体を自在に操って活躍することができた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Red 5.

'''Card text:'''
May add 1 pilot and 1 astromech. Immune to attrition < 4 if Luke is piloting. Power, maneuver, and hyperspeed may not be used without a pilot. If serving as the lead ship in Attack Run, add 1 to the total.

'''Lore:'''
The Incom T-65 X-wing Luke used at the Battle of Yavin. Red 5 and the T-16 skyhopper have similar controls, so Luke could fly this craft freely and take a leading role.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed subtype is 宇宙戦闘機：Xウイング. Japanese adds 1 if it is the lead ship.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Red 5]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
